rules: No Inter / Roboto / Space Grotesk on headings
Headings use 'Manrope Variable' with tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter) and weights 700 or 800
Overlines, coordinate tags, step numbers, and technical metadata MUST use 'JetBrains Mono Variable' uppercase with tracking-[0.2em] (text-xs or text-sm)
Body paragraphs use 'DM Sans Variable' text-base (16px) with leading-relaxed (line-height 1.7) for maximum readability in French and English

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the exact color tokens in frontend/src/index.css using Tailwind v4 @theme inline and dark class by default on html
Install no unnecessary fonts or packages; use the bundled fontsource imports (@fontsource-variable/manrope, @fontsource-variable/dm-sans, @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono)
Implement the bilingual toggle (FR/EN) smoothly using a lightweight React context so the entire site can switch instantly without page reload
Keep all pricing quote-based as requested (no fake fixed price packages or fake testimonials)
Include the interactive before/after document transformation component on the Home page to make the value proposition palpable
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, form inputs, language switchers, and interactive cards for automated verification

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not make generic centered cards with purple gradients. Use dark navy (#070B14), metallic silver (#E2E8F0), blueprint borderlines (#1E293B), and monospace technical annotation tags
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Use generous spacing (py-24, gap-12) and sharp technical card styling with 1px hairline strokes and technical corner indicators
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use sonner for notifications on contact form submit and quote calculations
